statement: Boundary phase data and normalization at infinity alone do not uniquely identify the holomorphic fractional-power observable in the upper half-plane.
assumptions: 0<sigma<=1; holomorphic in H; continuous boundary values on R except 0; F(x) in R_+ for x>0 and exp(-i*pi*sigma)R_+ for x<0; z^sigma F(z) tends uniformly to 1 as |z| tends to infinity in H.

source.derivation: Saved independently before paired prover material was opened.

proof_or_counterexample: For any epsilon>0, F_epsilon(z)=exp(-sigma Log z)(1+epsilon/z^2) meets all assumptions and differs from F_0. Its stronger singularity at 0 shows the missing premise.
remaining_gap: This is a counterexample only to the abstract uniqueness inference; FK endpoint estimates and exact observable/source matching remain to be checked.

statement: A continuous real Loewner driver W starting at zero is Brownian with bracket 8t/(1+sigma) if, for every z=im with m a positive integer, the full complex observable exp(sigma(Log g'_t(z)-Log(g_t(z)-W_t))) is a continuous local martingale up to swallowing in the same usual filtration.
assumptions: sigma>0; capacity equation dg=2/(g-W)dt; consistent continuous logarithms; both real and imaginary components are local martingales; no time-dependent phase or normalization.

source.background: Duminil-Copin 2012, arXiv:1208.3787, Proposition 6 and conditional SLE discussion; this is an independent derivation of a known conditional route, not a novelty claim.

proof_or_counterexample: Recover W as a smooth local function of nonzero complex M and finite-variation g,g'; then Ito gives Z dA+(sigma+1)dV/2-4dt=0. Im(Z)>0 forces dA=0, and the real part fixes dV. Choose m^2>4T to ensure survival on every finite horizon.
remaining_gap: No proof that discrete FK observables converge to this complex martingale, including stopped uniform integrability and limiting filtration.

statement: Uniform almost-sure convergence of nonnegative cadlag martingale paths to a continuous process does not by itself preserve the martingale property.
assumptions: N is unit-rate Poisson; n positive integer; 0<=t<=1; prelimit natural filtration F^n_t generated by N_{s/n} for s<=t.
proof_or_counterexample: M^n_t=1-t+nN_{t/n} is a nonnegative true martingale. The first Poisson jump time is positive a.s., so eventually M^n=1-t on the entire interval. The deterministic continuous limit is not a martingale. Its expectation loss is t, witnessed by tail expectation >=n(1-exp(-t/n))->t.
remaining_gap: This rejects an inference without uniform integrability; an actual localized FK proof may establish the missing bounds.

statement: The historical C0049 attempt does not establish that an additional discrete relation is necessary for every proof; it describes one sufficient observable route. The full route also needs random-slit observable convergence and martingale transfer.
assumptions: Interpret the source node as a dated, author-checked attempt, not a theorem-equivalence proof.
